# Contributing

Contributions are welcome. Please open an issue first to discuss the change you'd like to make before submitting a pull request.

## Setup

```bash
composer install
```

## Testing

```bash
composer test
```

## Commit messages

Releases are automated with [semantic-release](https://github.com/semantic-release/semantic-release), so commits must follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) spec (e.g. `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`).

## Pull requests

- Fork the repository and create a feature branch.
- Keep changes focused — one PR per feature or fix.
- Add tests covering your change.
- Run the full test suite (`composer test`) before opening the PR.
